info.title: Blackboard 2.0 API
info.description: Hand-edited, based on autogenerated version by the swagger-autogen module.

post.description: Log teacher in and create a new session (if sessionid == 0) or join an existing one.  Also returns a valid presenter-level access token for socket.io broadcasting.

requestBody.description: Details for the new presentation when creating one.

get.description: Get information on current sessions. Note: this is public info,  so we do NOT return passwords - only a boolean if the viewerpw is set or not

patch.description: Log teacher in and create a new session (if sessionid == 0) or join an existing one.  Also returns a valid presenter-level access token for socket.io broadcasting.

requestBody.description: Update json in the presentation settings DB field

200.description: Sessions successfully fetched (token is only returned if presenterpw is changed).

get.description: Get an array of distinct colors used on current shapes  (mode lets one choose between stroke or fill colors).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Set to fill or stroke, depending on which colors you wish to be returned

200.description: Sessions successfully fetched (token is only returned if presenterpw is changed).

requestBody.description: Data of shape to be created

get.description: Get a single shape by id (not used at the moment).

patch.description: Change properties of a single shape. NOTE: shapedetails is a special case but it can be given as partial json object

delete.description: Mark a batch of shapes as invisible. Specify also the board to mark it as modified

200.description: Shape successfully created. Note: returns board id only

requestBody.description: Array of ids for shapes to delete, board to delete from

put.description: Clone a shape. The database id of shape to clone and new x and y coordinates are required in the request body

requestBody.description: Id of a shape to clone, new x and y coordinates

patch.description: Batch change the color of one or more shapes of a presentation

requestBody.description: Array of shapes to recolor, new color value

patch.description: Restore most recently deleted shape of a given board. Returns board id of the deleted shape.

delete.description: Delete the most recently drawn/restored shape of a given board. Returns board id of the deleted shape.

get.description: Get color, settings and limits of all boards in a presentation.
Get the board properties and contents for a single board by id. If the board id is not found in the DB, add one using the currently selected background color and grid settings.

patch.description: Patch the background color and settings for a board by id.

requestBody.description: Update json in the presentation settings DB field

delete.description: Delete all boards from a blackboard presentation and reset settings.

options.description: Fetch image data from external URL and return it with all origins allowed to circumvent CORS limitations with reading the canvas data on client.

get.description: Fetch image data from external URL and return it with all origins allowed to circumvent CORS limitations with reading the canvas data on client.
Convert all boards into pdf format.
